//: THE WALL. `composite` defaults rootDir to this directory, so a relative reach into a sibling block or into the spine is a resolution error, not a lint message. `references` names the one project this block may see. `*.test.ts` is excluded because the co-located test is a RESIDENT of the folder rather than part of the shipped package: it is type-checked by the root program, which is what lets it drive the shared test rig while the package itself stays walled - and it is what keeps the wall from compiling a test into `.tsbuild`, where vitest would execute it.
